results.name: reporter UUID filter sends only the requested reporter and filters visible reports
target-user and combined UUID filters preserve both query fields
invalid UUID is rejected before any list request
target-user filter alone selects its matching report
clear filters restores both reports
details show only selected material and make no automatic binary requests
explicit image preview uses current auth and a blob URL with no-store and redirect refusal
switching image previews releases the prior blob and leaves exactly one active preview
video fixture decodes and switching away pauses and releases its source
selected-message attachment also uses its report-bound authenticated route
close detail revokes the last preview
rapid pending preview switch aborts the old owner and creates only the final blob
403 on a fresh read retires the previous blob and clears details without fallback
available=false metadata cannot render stale body or fetch old evidence URLs
closing while bytes are delayed cannot publish a late blob
actual auth-boundary event clears preview and private detail
explicit visibility fixture runs the production hidden-page cleanup
read-only administrator may view detail but cannot enter mutation
manage opens the existing MFA form without sending a step-up or mutation
